subject: Provisioning artifacts and privilege matrix request for SIG/CAIQ
messages:
From: Tom Willis <tom.willis@finhealth.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: security@finhealth.com
Date: Tue, 09 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG/CAIQ: IAM evidence & privilege matrix

Hi Laura,

We're working through FinHealth's SIG/CAIQ intake and need a short bundle of IAM/provisioning artifacts to complete our review. Can you provide the following items or point us to a secure drop? Preferably we need these by EOD Friday (5/12):

- Privilege/role matrix for Redwood production tenants (CSV) — roles, privileges, number of principals per role
- SCIM delta/sync logs for the last monthly window (preferably April 2028)
- Sample SAML assertions (redacted) for an interactive user login and a service account token exchange
- List of service accounts and owner contact for the production env
- Short note describing RBAC model (how least-privilege is enforced; who can grant role changes)

Links to a shared Drive folder or a signed SFTP drop would work. If anything requires a POA or access agreement, flag it and we'll expedite.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Tom Willis
Sr. Security Architect, FinHealth
Tom.Willis@finhealth.com
+1 (415) 555-8210


From: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
To: Tom Willis <tom.willis@finhealth.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 09 May 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ: IAM evidence & privilege matrix

Tom — thanks for the checklist. We can deliver the artifacts by EOD Friday. Quick notes and owners below: 

- Privilege matrix (CSV): Marcus Lin will owner and redact IDs as appropriate — target 5/12 EOD.
- SCIM delta/sync logs: we will provide a zip of delta logs for April 2028; contains only metadata and hashed user ids.
- SAML assertions (samples): we'll include two samples (interactive + service-account) with PII redacted.
- Service account inventory: included in the CSV; Marcus will flag any long-lived keys and contact owners.
- RBAC note: short one-page writeup included describing role hierarchy and change process.

Marcus/Sean — please confirm attachments and whether we need additional redaction or a legal access form for the Drive link. Tom — would you prefer a Google Drive folder (shared with FinHealth security) or a signed SFTP key? Drive is fastest but we can do SFTP if you need a formal drop.

Thanks,
Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
+1 (650) 555-0192

From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, Tom Willis <tom.willis@finhealth.com>
Cc: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 11 May 2028 14:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ: IAM evidence & privilege matrix

Laura / Tom — attaching the requested artifacts to the Drive folder referenced below. Stubs attached here for your visibility: 

Attachments (uploaded to Drive folder):
- redwood_role_matrix_v2.csv (columns: role_id, role_name, description, permissions_list, principal_count, owner_email)
- scim_delta_sync_202804.zip (contains sync manifest and delta records; user identifiers hashed + salt)
- sso_saml_assertions_sample.txt (two samples: interactive_user_assertion.txt, svcacct_token_assertion.txt; names redacted)

Notes: 
- Service accounts: we've included owner_email where available. There are 18 service accounts in prod; 3 are flagged for rotation in the next 30 days.
- Least-privilege: short cadence note attached (rbac_practice_summary.txt) that explains our monthly role review and automated provisioning guardrails.
- Redaction: PII removed; mapping keys stored in our internal vault and not shared.

If you need the raw logs un-hashed under an NDA, let us know and we can route through legal.

Drive link (private share): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cREDWOOD-FINHEALTH-ARTIFACTS

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai

From: Tom Willis <tom.willis@finhealth.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, security@finhealth.com
Date: Fri, 12 May 2028 17:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ: IAM evidence & privilege matrix

Laura / Marcus — received everything and the samples look good. A couple quick follow-ups before we close the control: 

- Can you include a one-paragraph attestation describing the role-pruning schedule (who signs off and typical cadence)? That can be an emailed statement from Laura.
- For the three service accounts flagged for rotation, please include the expected rotation dates or a mitigation note.

If you can send the attestation and the dates in one email, we should be able to close the IAM section. Thanks for the fast turnaround.

Tom
Tom Willis
Sr. Security Architect, FinHealth
